headline: Bastigor ice mount
title: Bastigor | Ice Hammer Mount And Cooling Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Cooling your Palworld one point zero base? Bastigor is a World Tree Pal found at roughly level seventy five to eighty. You can ride it, and its partner skill, Blizzard Crash, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from ice. At base it works Cooling level eight, Lumbering level six and Mining level five. Do you want Bastigor? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Ride it, swing an ice hammer

description: Bastigor in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable World Tree Ice Pal with Cooling level eight, Lumbering six and Mining five.
